concepts.name: neuron
concepts.definition: An excitable cell that receives, processes, and transmits information through electrical and chemical signals.

concepts.name: cell body
concepts.definition: The central part of a neuron that integrates incoming signals from dendrites and generates action potentials when membrane potential reaches threshold.

concepts.name: axon initial segment
concepts.definition: The specialized region of the axon where action potentials are initiated due to a high density of voltage-gated sodium channels.

concepts.name: action potential
concepts.definition: A transient electrical signal generated in a neuron when depolarization at the axon initial segment opens voltage-gated sodium channels, causing successive regions of the membrane to depolarize before returning toward the resting state.

concepts.name: excitable cell
concepts.definition: A biological cell capable of generating and propagating electrical signals, such as neurons and muscle cells.

concepts.name: dendrite
concepts.definition: Structural extensions of a neuron that receive incoming signals from other neurons or sensory inputs.

concepts.name: voltage-gated sodium channel
concepts.definition: A channel that opens upon depolarization.

concepts.name: depolarization
concepts.definition: A change in membrane potential that makes the inside of the cell more positive, often reaching a threshold to trigger action potentials.

concepts.name: opening of voltage-gated sodium channels
concepts.definition: The event where voltage-gated sodium channels transition to an open state, allowing sodium ions to flow into the cell and propagate depolarization.
